key_path: Sign up at resend.com/signup (email or social login)
Fastest agent path: connect remote MCP https://mcp.resend.com/mcp -> browser OAuth consent (no key copy needed); MCP/CLI/API can then create API keys
Alternative: Dashboard > API Keys > Create (Sending access or Full access, optional domain restriction) then `resend login --key re_...`
Send immediately from onboarding@resend.dev to own address / *@resend.dev test addresses; add + verify a domain (DNS) to send to anyone
human_gates: domain_verification (DNS records required to send to arbitrary recipients; sandbox sender only reaches account owner + resend.dev test addresses)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: partial - `resend login` stores a pasted key (masked prompt or --key); no browser/device login in CLI; multi-profile `resend auth switch`, `resend whoami`
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes - OAuth 2.1 + PKCE; DCR at POST https://api.resend.com/oauth/register (unauthenticated, 20/hr/IP) AND Client ID Metadata Documents (client_id_metadata_document_supported=true); remote MCP advertises RFC 9728 metadata
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes - POST /api-keys (API, CLI `resend api-keys create`, and MCP)
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes - full_access vs sending_access, optionally restricted to one domain
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: yes - onboarding@resend.dev sender and delivered@/bounced@/complained@resend.dev simulation addresses (count against quota)

mcp.product_mcp_local: yes - local MCP server with RESEND_API_KEY also documented
mcp.docs_mcp: Mintlify docs (llms.txt + .md); remote MCP is product MCP
mcp.one_click: Claude connector directory (claude.ai/directory/connectors/resend), `claude plugin install resend@claude-plugins-official`, Cursor `/add-plugin resend`, Codex one-click plugin, VS Code JSON, Hermes/Grok plugins; Agent Plugins spec bundle (MCP + skills)

docs_for_agents.markdown_pages: yes - every docs page at .md with 'Documentation Index' header pointing agents to llms.txt
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - listed under OpenAPI Specs in docs llms.txt
docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: Agent Skills: resend/resend-skills, resend/resend-cli skill, React Email skill, email best-practices skill, agent inbox skill

time_to_first_call_notes: Signup + email verify + one OAuth consent click, then agent sends a test email from onboarding@resend.dev. Sending to customers additionally needs DNS verification (minutes if agent has DNS access).
agent_friendliness_justification: Remote OAuth MCP with DCR+CIMD, key-minting API/CLI/MCP, non-interactive JSON CLI with idempotency keys, sandbox sender and free tier; only signup/email verify and domain DNS need a human.
best_practice: Ship the CLI with an explicit agent mode (auto JSON on non-TTY, stable error codes, stdin piping, --idempotency-key) and document it on a dedicated 'CLI for AI agents' page.
biggest_gap: No agent-initiated signup or device-flow CLI login; production sending still blocked on domain DNS verification.
